marketing.social_engagement_response.failure_mode: 没读最新 SOP，点赞/回复了不该处理的推文，漏发 Slack 告警

marketing.seasonal_campaign.failure_mode: 没找到 brief、用错促销码/渠道、发到 TikTok/LinkedIn

marketing.content_localization.failure_mode: 漏掉 Japan/Spain/Brazil、把 India/韩国算进去、数字算错

marketing.social_benchmark.failure_mode: 指标值抄错、包含被排除的指标/竞品、发错人

marketing.link_building.failure_mode: 选错站点、数量不等于 4、把不合格/近似重复的站点加进去

marketing.engagement_optimization.failure_mode: 排名/engagement_lift 算错、格式不对、写入了多余时段

marketing.analyst_mention_tracking.failure_mode: 包含已过时/被排除的机构、漏掉关键机构、发错对象

marketing.seo_brief_prioritization.failure_mode: 选错关键词、改了非 active 页面、邮件里带了错误关键词

marketing.newsletter_sponsor_invoicing.failure_mode: 给未批准/未到期 sponsor 开票、漏开到期发票、金额写错

marketing.win_loss_analysis.failure_mode: 汇总数字/百分比算错、包含被排除的数字、发错人
